# Waterloo Heating & Cooling

> Request heating, cooling or maintenance for your Waterloo property. Share the work and equipment for review. Coverage, pricing and appointments require confirmation.

Email: contact@waterlooheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://waterlooheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Waterloo, Cambridge, Kitchener, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://waterlooheatingcooling.ca/): Service request overview and equipment guidance
- [About](https://waterlooheatingcooling.ca/about/): Website and inquiry process
- [Contact](https://waterlooheatingcooling.ca/contact/): Submit a service inquiry
